name: Geronimo
mentions: Newspapers have, since the surrender of Geronimo and Natchez to Gen. Miles, used up columns of abuse on the General for his alleged lenient terms to his prisoners. It now transpires that the Apaches surrendered uncondi…
A short editorial reacting to a report from Florida that Apache prisoners of Geronimo's band were dying at a rate of four a day, and declaring they should have been hanged when captured.
